sources.title: Phi-4 14B - Open Source AI Models
sources.snippet: 14B model trained primarily on synthetic data. Punches above its weight on reasoning, especially MATH and GPQA. MIT licensed. A standout choice when you want strong reasoning quality without paying 70B-tier hardware costs. Phi-4 in particular demonstrated that careful synthetic-data curation can extract frontier-class reasoning from a relatively small dense model.

sources.title: Phi-4: 14B Model with Synthetic Data
sources.snippet: This report introduces phi-4, a 14-billion parameter language model leveraging synthetic data and advanced post-training to excel in reasoning tasks.

sources.title: Phi-4 14B - 16k context, open source | LLM Reference
sources.snippet: Phi-4 14B is an open-source model in the Phi-4 family. The structured metadata tracks a 16k-token context window and structured outputs. This page tracks provider routes through OpenRouter, Fireworks AI, and Microsoft Foundry, with the cheapest tracked route listed at $0.065 input and $0.14 output per 1M tokens.
